automatic_rule: Native XOR EAX,EAX; MOV AL,[ECX+2]; MOV AL,[EAX+table]; RET. Named C reads an unsigned byte index then table byte. Complete EAX is0..255. Canonical entry restores caller registers/nonarithmetic flags, repeats actual XOR for native arithmetic flags, and retains the returned EAX.
